vector3.history.title: History
vector3.track.title: Tracks
vector3.keyframe.name: Name
vector3.keyframe.bypass_shaders.tooltip: With a shader pack active: draw this unshaded together with the other shapes, so it occludes and is occluded by them correctly. Off: the shader pack shades it like the world.
vector3.keyframe_type.name: Shape
vector3.shape_manager.title: Shape Manager
vector3.shape_manager.copy_hint: Drag onto a shape to parent it, right-click to edit, middle-click to copy ID
vector3.look_to.ends_scope.tooltip: From a keyframe until the next one, the camera looks at the target, moving toward the next keyframe's target. A keyframe marked End Scope stops it and only provides that final target.
vector3.skip.ends_scope.tooltip: Playback and export jump from a start keyframe straight to the next End Skip keyframe. Scrubbing while paused still shows the skipped part.
vector3.prefab.drag_hint: Drag onto the timeline, or double-click to place at the cursor.
vector3.prefab.name: Name
vector3.prefab.skipped_block_overrides: Block Override keyframes can't be saved in a prefab and were left out.
vector3.dolly_zoom.ends_scope.tooltip: From a keyframe until the next one, the camera follows the target, blending distance, framing and direction toward the next keyframe. A keyframe marked End Scope stops it.
vector3.dolly_zoom.frame_height.tooltip: How many blocks tall the view is at the target's distance. Keep it the same between keyframes for a dolly zoom: the target keeps its size while the background stretches.
vector3.shape_manager.instant_preview.to: Apply keyframes live while dragging them on the timeline, instead of only on release
vector3.keyframe.glow_sdf_only: Glow only works with custom (.ttf/.otf) fonts
vector3.gizmo.place_hint: Middle click: move to the block/entity under the cursor (Ctrl: snap to the block cell)
vector3.shape_manager.drop_to_unparent: Drop here to remove its parent
vector3.eyedropper.entity_tooltip: Pick an entity in the viewport
vector3.eyedropper.shape_tooltip: Pick a shape in the viewport
vector3.eyedropper.hint: Click a target in the viewport (right click / Esc to cancel)
vector3.shape_manager.auto_key.tooltip: Picking a shape with nothing selected edits it at the playhead; moving it creates a keyframe there
vector3.properties.title: Properties
vector3.properties.empty: Select a keyframe on the timeline to edit it here.
vector3.curve.hint: Shapes the time from this keyframe to the next. Drag points and handles (Alt: break handle, Ctrl: snap), double-click to add, right-click to remove.
vector3.multi.locked: Values differ. Hold Ctrl to unlock and set them all.
vector3.properties.clipboard_hint: %s rows selected · %s on clipboard · Ctrl+right-click to select, Ctrl+C / Ctrl+V
vector3.clips.title: Clips
vector3.clips.drag_hint: Drag a replay onto the timeline to add it as a clip. Order clips by dragging them on the Clips track, then apply.
vector3.clips.range_hint: Source ticks, 0 to %s. Apply to take effect.
vector3.clips.incompatible_detail: It was recorded on %s, this project on %s.
vector3.clips.composing_hint: You can keep editing; the replay reopens once the clips are composed.
vector3.loop.ends_scope.tooltip: Playback and export jump from here back to the previous Loop keyframe until its repeats are used up.
vector3.loop.count.tooltip: How many extra times the section plays. 1 plays it twice. Pausing the replay resets the count.
vector3.fade.opacity.tooltip: 0 shows the scene, 1 covers it completely. Keyframes blend between each other; use two keyframes for a fade in or out.
vector3.repeat.tooltip: Repeats this track's keyframes after its last one.
vector3.ripple.nothing: Ripple delete: no time to close
vector3.ripple.overlap: Ripple delete: keyframes would land on each other
vector3.camera_preview.title: Camera Preview
vector3.camera_preview.iris: The camera preview is off while a shader pack is in use. Tick the box above to try it anyway.
vector3.camera_preview.no_camera: No camera keyframes at the playhead.
vector3.shortcuts.title: Shortcuts
vector3.shortcuts.gizmo_snap: Hold Ctrl while dragging|Snap to steps
vector3.shortcuts.select_shape: Right-click a shape|Select its nearest keyframe
vector3.shortcuts.place: Middle-click|Move the selected shape to the block under the mouse
vector3.shortcuts.place_face: Ctrl + middle-click|Place against the block face instead
vector3.shortcuts.duplicate: Ctrl+D (viewport / Shape Manager)|Duplicate the selected shapes with their keyframes
vector3.shortcuts.delete_shape: Delete (viewport / Shape Manager)|Delete the selected shapes
vector3.shortcuts.focus: F|Focus the shape or block under the mouse
vector3.shortcuts.split: Ctrl+B|Split every clip and audio bar under the playhead
vector3.shortcuts.blade: Middle-click a clip or audio bar|Split it at the mouse
vector3.shortcuts.trim: Drag a clip or audio edge|Trim
vector3.shortcuts.alt_copy: Alt + drag keyframes|Copy instead of move
vector3.shortcuts.ripple: Ctrl+Delete|Ripple delete: delete and close the gap on every track
vector3.shortcuts.track_select: Click / Ctrl-click / Shift-click a track name|Select tracks
vector3.shortcuts.track_box: Drag in the track list|Box-select tracks
vector3.shortcuts.track_copy: Alt + drag a track handle|Copy the track
vector3.help.title: Help
vector3.camera_preview.with_shaders.tool: Renders the world twice per frame through the shader pack. It costs about double, and effects that reuse the previous frame (TAA, motion blur, auto exposure) may smear or flicker between the two views.
vector3.camera_preview.detach: Main view doesn't follow the camera
vector3.camera_preview.detach.tooltip: While this window is open, camera keyframes (position, FOV, shake, Look To, Dolly Zoom) only drive the preview, so the main view stays where you put it during playback. Exports are unaffected.
vector3.keyframe.obj_mode.mtl.tooltip: Uses the .mtl files the OBJ names (mtllib / usemtl): each material's colour (Kd), opacity (d) and texture (map_Kd), found next to the OBJ. Colour still tints the whole model.
vector3.entity_pose.mode.tooltip: Replace: switched-on rotations hold exactly these values; offsets are from the part's rest position. Add: rotation and offset go on top of what the part already has. Several tracks can pose one entity: they apply in track order, each on top of the one above, and channels left off keep what they had.
vector3.entity_pose.capture.tooltip: Copies the entity's pose as it is animated right now into this keyframe, for every part.
vector3.entity_pose.not_loaded: The entity isn't loaded at the playhead.
vector3.entity_pose.no_parts: Pick a loaded entity to list its model parts.
vector3.entity_pose.part.head: Head
vector3.entity_pose.gizmo_part: Edit this part with the viewport gizmo (or right-click its marker there)
vector3.entity_pose.rotate.tooltip: Drive this part's rotation from this track. Leave it off to let another track (or the animation) drive it.
vector3.entity_pose.move.tooltip: Drive this part's offset from this track. Leave it off to let another track (or the animation) drive it.
